response.strategyText: This authored first encounter feels like a test of persistence rather than power. I am proud of my familiar bugs, Caterpie and Metapod, but I am cautious about public hype and the pressure to perform immediately. With no new levels, companions, or supplies, I must rely entirely on the ordinary tactics that have carried me so far. My finite inventory offers no healing items, so every decision must conserve resources and avoid unnecessary damage. I have a move-change budget of two, which I will likely reserve for critical adjustments rather than speculative swaps. The legal preparation envelope allows only one active roster, and I will preserve my signature companions as they are. The authorized reports indicate a recent battle involving a Bulbasaur, which suggests my opponent may favor grass-types or have access to similar creatures. However, these reports are from a single source and may not predict the next battle accurately. I intend to use String Shot to slow down any fast threats and Harden to absorb hits while setting up. My fighting intention is to outlast my opponent through endurance and status control, not through raw strength. I acknowledge the uncertainty of the unseen party and unannounced moves, and I will adapt as the battle unfolds, but I will not gamble away my limited resources. This is a cautious, methodical approach, grounded in the reality of what I have and what I know.
